qa: No, it isn't deleted yet. Once all of the processing for the activated effect has resolved, a rule check will occur, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn. Then, if it's your turn, 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into [Silphymon] in the hand.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing your top security card, it isn't deleted.)
